t: Inventory & Orders Ledger – Reorder Point and Shipping Cost Calculator

A free tool for rebuilding your supplier and product catalog, calculating reorder points, creating purchase orders, allocating shipping costs, and running manual inventory counts, with results exported and no account or connection needed.
Complete inventory and orders ledger in your browser

This tool lets you create and manage an inventory and orders catalog entirely in your browser, with no sign-up or server storage; you can enter data manually or import a CSV file, then calculate the reorder point and suggested quantity based on current stock and expected usage, issue purchase orders with partial receipts, allocate shipping and customs costs to units to determine actual cost, run manual stock counts that show variances, and export all results locally as JSON or CSV.

You can try the app here for free in your browser. If you want it tailored to your business (your data, fields, reports, and logo) with handover, a walkthrough, and support, we prepare it for 79 USDT per project, with payment in USDT on Polygon after confirming the domain.
Can data be saved between sessions?
No, the app runs entirely in your browser and stores nothing on the server. You can export the data manually and save it on your device.
Does the app support Excel files?
It only supports CSV files for import, and you can convert Excel files to CSV before use.
The "Allocate costs" button adds shipping and customs costs to the unit cost based on the entered values (simple simulation).
The "Manual stock count" button opens a space to record variances, and you can add these values manually in future versions.
Does the app work in all browsers?
Yes, it uses standard JavaScript and does not rely on features unsupported in modern browsers.
